hooks.text: 把陷阱、电力、自动炮塔与自动门整合进可破坏的僵尸防御堡垒
hooks.excerpt: Design your fort to include traps, electric power, auto turrets, automated doors, gadgets and defensive positions to survive the undead in a fully destructible and moldable world.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 建筑与地形遵循真实结构稳定性，受损或设计不良会因自重坍塌
hooks.excerpt: Buildings and terrain formations can collapse under their own weight from structural damage or poor building design with real structural stability.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 可在固定战役与随机世界间选择，随机地图包含城市、洞穴等700多个地点
hooks.excerpt: Play the campaign world, or dive back in a randomly-generated world with cities, towns, lakes, mountains, valleys, roads, caves and over 700 unique locations.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
